item.title: Purim in Kharkiv Celebrated Amidst War
item.description: The city of Kharkiv and its Jewish community are well known throughout Ukraine and around the world for their resilience and strength — not only surviving four years of war and life on the frontlines, but continuing to grow and emerge even stronger. Full Story

item.title: New Campus Shluchim in Williamstown, MA
item.description: Rabbi Mendel and Tzivia Volovik (nee Treitel) are establishing the first Chabad Center at Williams College in Williamstown, Massachusetts. Full Story

item.title: Picture of the Day
item.description: On Purim a group of girls who learn in memory of Matilda Bee HY"D, the youngest victim of the Bondi terror attack, dressed up as bees to spread light and in her memory. More

item.title: Dr. Eileen Weiss, 86, OBM
item.description: Dr. Eileen Weiss, a beloved mother, grandmother, and great-grandmother whose 15 children were a miracle after a blessing from the Rebbe, passed away on Tuesday, 14 Adar, Purim, 5786. Full Story

item.title: NYPD Commissioner Joins Purim Festivities in Crown Heights
item.description: Senior NYPD officials joined a Purim celebration in Crown Heights at the home of community activist Rabbi Chanina Sperlin. Full Story

item.title: Moscow Celebrates Miracles in Israel with Grand Melava Malkah
item.description: The annual gathering for friends and supporters of the “Central Gemach Fund of the Former Soviet Union,” in Moscow turned into a seudas hoda’ah to Hashem for the miracles happening in Eretz Yisroel. Full Story, Photos, Video

item.title: Israel to Reopen Airspace in Phased Manner Amid War
item.description: Israel plans to reopen Ben Gurion Airport ahead of schedule, now as early as Wednesday night. The accelerated schedule aims to rapidly repatriate stranded Israelis. Video

item.title: Live: 30 Letters in 30 Days
item.description: Live at 10:00 PM ET: Rabbi Shais Taub re-launches his annual “Thirty Letters in Thirty Days” live series, beginning Motzei Shabbos at 10 PM ET, as a 30-day preparation for the Rebbe’s birthday featuring nightly classes on letters from Volume 12 of Igros Kodesh. Live

item.title: Hundreds Celebrate Purim at Chabad of Koh Samui, Thailand
item.description: Hundreds of Jewish travelers and locals gathered in Koh Samui, Thailand, to celebrate Purim in a lively and uplifting atmosphere at the local Chabad House led by Shliach Rabbi Mendy Goldshmid. Full Story

item.title: Texas Shabbaton Visits First Mikvah on a Collage Campus
item.description: Jewish students from universities across Texas and beyond gathered in College Station for the 17th Annual Texas Shabbaton, a weekend of Jewish pride, inspiration, and unity hosted by Chabad at Texas A&M University. The highlight was a visit to the new Mikvah on campus. Full Story, Photos
